how_to_voice: Its OWN unbroken take (a different length is a different script): outputs/vo-take-cam-v3-short/take.m4a laid at 0.0 s. The page uses motion/af.js ANCHORS_SHORT (the unused stretches of the authored timeline are collapsed).
character: One dry Kiwi storyteller for Q-S-me (Cam S, ElevenLabs voice 53CG2aO2HU48thT3QnMl, eleven_v3): the straight-talking mate who reads the small print out loud. General NZ accent, never a caricature, no announcer lift, no exclamation marks. Facts flat and plain; the two self-owns ('They knew.' and 'We know.') thrown away, never pushed. Continuous speech: the narration never stops for more than 1 s.

settings.note: v3 only accepts stability 0.0 / 0.5 / 1.0; no style/speed/similarity

pronunciation.QSME: written 'Queue Ess Mee' in the text sent to ElevenLabs (STT hears 'QS Me' / 'QSme'); in text_v2 it is 'Q-S-me'
pronunciation.qsme.co.nz: Queue Ess Mee dot Co dot N Z ("co" said like KO, never C-O; owner 2026-10-08)
pronunciation.LIM / PIM: said as words (lim, pim); STT hears them as LIM, PIM

take.method: ONE unbroken request to /v1/text-to-speech/53CG2aO2HU48thT3QnMl/with-timestamps (model eleven_v3, stability 0.5); never sliced; laid onto outputs/auckland-first-9x16-short.mp4 at 0.0 s at gain 1.15 with tools/mux, no bed. Earlier takes (2026-10-06, CTA said "dot co") are archived in outputs/archive/vo-take-cam-v3-short-co/.
take.stt_check: tools/el.py stt 2026-10-10: every word heard; QSME heard as 'QS Me' and 'qsme.co.nz' (the KO pronunciation the owner asked for) in the CTA

continuous_read_v3:
Not in Auckland? Every nationwide property tool has an asterisk. Here's ours, read out loud.

Fair test: we typed each council's own address into Queue Ess Mee site search. Dunedin first. Anywhere in the country you get the basics: boundary, land area, legal description, and council. Services and hazards? Not here yet. It says so, right on the card. So we told Dunedin City Council it's in Dunedin City. They knew.

Screenshot this. Everywhere: the basics. Three more councils: plus the zone. Auckland: the lot.

Yeah. We started in Auckland. We know. [dry] Card says so.

Search your address. Sign up at Queue Ess Mee dot Co dot N Z.
